note: travels_jet (Focus.lean) carries the display for all jet orders, applied along the subsequence and scaling from pays_sky, which supplies Approaches. [L] evaluates the correlation at r_i x itself, not at the rounded grid points r_i x^(i). The rounding error vanishes uniformly by the first-jet convergence.

lemma travels_jet (H : S.Hierarchy) (h : W.Derivatives S) (L : (Bel C.book).Hierarchy) (hp : V.Derivatives (Bel C.book))
    (X : Scaling S) (ht : Approaches (path X) (isoPanel X)) (v : ℕ → Ribbon (Bel C.book) t) (x : Ribbon (Bel C.book) t)
    (hv : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun k => v k i) atTop (𝓝 (x i)))
    (j : ℕ) (s : Set (Points n)) (hs : IsCompact s) (hu : s ⊆ conf n) (ε : ℝ) (he : 0<ε) :
    ∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ y∈s,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (tested (X.r k) (isoPanel X k) (hang t (v k))) y - iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (disc (hang t x)) y‖ ≤ ε := by
  filter_upwards [(closed_path H h L hp X ht n).jets (show Travels n X _ from ⟨t,v,x,hv,rfl⟩) s hs hu j he] with k hk y hy
  specialize hk y hy
  -- symmetry/derivative closure is inside conf
  have hh := ((smoothZoom H.smooth (panels (isoPanel X k) ∘ (hang t (v k))) (X.positive k)) _ (hu hy)).contDiffAt
    ((conf_open _).mem_nhds (hu hy))
  have hF := cont_disc L (hang t x) (hu hy)
  rw [← iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (show ContDiffAt ℝ (j : WithTop ℕ∞) (tested (X.r k) (isoPanel X k) (hang t (v k))) y from
    hh.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)) (hF.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top))]; exact hk

proof_context.conclusion: For a scaling with Approaches, labels v_k→x and compact s in the configuration space, the j-th derivative of tested(r_k, U_k, v_k) minus that of the free correlation is eventually at most epsilon uniformly on s.

theorem pays_sky (hG:G.Simple)(hX: Scrim C W u ψ φ δ (fly C.path.levels) r L) {z:ℕ →ℝ}
   (hZ:∀ i j, i≤j→ generator G i≤z j) (h : ∀ d,FiresSky B H O J d (z d))(hD:DimAbove S) (𝓛:Ultrafilter (ℕ×ℕ))(hℓ:(𝓛:Filter _)≤ F.fuse) (s:ℕ→ℝ)(hS:Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 0))(hp:∀ i,0<s i): ∃ f:ℕ→ℕ,StrictMono f ∧ ∃ X:Scaling S,X.r=s ∘ f ∧ StarPath F a X hs 𝓛:= by
   obtain ⟨v,V,hF,h',hκ,hV⟩:= wakesSky B H O J F a P hs.smooth he hG hX hZ h s hS hp
   let X:Zoom:=⟨s∘v,(fun _=> hp _),h', hS.comp hF.tendsto_atTop⟩
   obtain ⟨Y,hY,hA,hu,hZ⟩:= dockedSky hs P a H X V (fun i=> (hV i).1) (fun i=> (hV i).2) 𝓛 hℓ hD
   have hr:Y.r=s ∘ v:= congr_arg Zoom.r hY
   exact ⟨v,hF,Y,hr,⟨hA,hu,V,hκ,fun i=> ⟨(hV i).1,(hV i).2.trans (congr_fun hr i).symm⟩, hZ⟩⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Every positive null sequence s has a strictly increasing f and a scaling X with X.r=s∘f satisfying StarPath, including Approaches.
